section.title: Stores
section.description: A store connects under Hoard's connections in Initiative. Hoard tells it what it may sell from the locations mapped here.
section.noLocations: Read the store again to see its locations.

sync.title: Sync with {{channel}}
sync.started: The sync has started. You can leave this page: it carries on.

about.reads: Hoard reads the store's products and variants, with their titles, descriptions, images, prices and visibility; its locations; how much of each item it holds and what each cost; and its orders from the last 60 days, each with its customer number. From then on Hoard keeps every order, so its history grows past what the store keeps.
about.replaces: Where a Hoard product already matches one in the store (by SKU, then title), the store's version replaces Hoard's, and Hoard's stock counts are set to the store's.
about.sends: Nothing is sent to the store. A big store can take a while: you can leave this page, and the sync carries on.

locations.description: Where each store location's stock goes
locations.loadFailed: The store's locations couldn't be read.

after.keeps: The store keeps syncing. Its orders and product changes come into Hoard as they happen, and when Hoard's stock changes (a production run, a purchase, a stocktake), Hoard sends the new count to the store.
after.remove: To stop, come back here and choose Remove sync; everything already in Hoard stays.

sync.removeBody: Hoard stops hearing from the store and stops sending it stock counts. Everything the sync brought into Hoard stays: products, locations, stock, orders and listings. Syncing again later replaces what conflicts, as the first sync did.
